steps.title: Start at the Dashboard
steps.narration: Every session starts here on the Dashboard — let's head into the Research area to see what's new this time.
steps.point_out: The familiar left sidebar, with Research as the seventh item.

steps.title: Open the Research hub
steps.narration: Research now has a new section beneath its usual lineup of labs — a running list of every idea the system has ever logged before testing it.
steps.point_out: Below the original ten labs, a new "Governance & process" heading introduces one card: "Pre-registration registry."

steps.title: Open the pre-registration registry
steps.narration: This new page lists every idea the system has ever logged for testing — its reasoning, when it was logged, and where it came from — all in one place.
steps.point_out: Eleven rows, each with plain-language reasoning, a registration date, and small readable tags like "factor=vcp_contraction" instead of raw code. Every row carries a calm gray "backfill" badge next to its status — never colored red or green — and one row even reads "closed" instead of "tested."

steps.title: Confirm the original hub is untouched
steps.narration: Heading back to Research shows the original ten labs exactly where they've always been — the new list lives alongside them, not in place of anything.
steps.point_out: The same ten lab cards in the same order, starting with "Factor Lab" — nothing removed or reshuffled to make room.

steps.title: Check that nothing else changed
steps.narration: A quick look at the existing Evidence page confirms this new addition didn't disturb anything else in the product.
steps.point_out: All seven tracked claims still show their honest red FAIL badge, exactly as before.

steps.title: Jump straight to the registry any time
steps.narration: The new page also works as a direct link on its own — no need to click through Research every time to reach it.
steps.point_out: The same eleven rows load right away on a fresh visit, each still dated 2026-07-03.
